findings.quote: Using a mass of 6 kg by mistake instead of the given 4 kg gives ½ × 6 × 21 = 63 J.
findings.note: Substituting a mass that appears nowhere in the question is not an error a student makes here; it is an arithmetic route invented to land on option 2. The entry teaches nothing about this question, unlike the other two entries, which name real errors.

notes: Own solve: v² = 2² + (−4)² + (−1)² = 21 m² s⁻², KE = ½ × 4 × 21 = 42 J. Both step equations are correct. common_mistakes[0] (84 J, one-half dropped) and common_mistakes[2] (21 J, reporting v²) verify exactly.
